merged.title: feat(port): open the menu with Start+Select instead of L3
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** L3 opened the in-game menu by default. But L3 does things in the game: in rac1 it shows the health and bolt counter for a few seconds, and held in the jet fighter (Pokitaru, Gemlik, Drek's Fleet) it turns sharper. Opening the menu also pressed those.

**After:** Start and Select pressed together open and close the menu. The game never sees the pair, so it neither pauses nor opens the map. A lone Start or Select still reaches the game: after at most 100 ms, or at once as a tap when let go sooner. The start-up hint shows "` or Start + Select". Android Back and Guide open the drawer as before. An old settings file with the L3 default moves to Start+Select; a button the player picked stays.

**How:** `platform/menu_chord` filters each port's pad in `Input::refresh_pads` and reports the pair; the overlay opens the menu from it, and closes it on the pair from SDL events while open. The setting is now `menu_button` (`start+back` by default); the old `menu_bar_button` is read once.

merged.title: fix: make right stick sensitivity speed up the camera
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** Stick sensitivity only scaled the stick reading. A full push is already the largest value the game reads, so at 300% the camera turned at the same speed as at 100% (only small pushes changed).

**After:** Above 100%, the right stick turns the follow camera faster at a full push, up to the set amount (300% = 3x). At 100% nothing changes.

**How:** `tune_stick` returns how far past a full push the sensitivity took the right stick's x (`Pad::camera_speed`). The game hosts multiply the follow camera's yaw target by it when it comes from the stick (rac1 PAL/NTSC, rac2: `camera_latch.c`), and the late camera latch uses the same factor. Vertical look is left alone (the game eases pitch to an angle, not a speed). Locked or scripted camera turns are not touched.

**Tested:** headless build, ctest (143/143, new checks in `bindings_test`). Not tested in game (no disc in the container); please try 100% and 300% in game. rac3/rac4 have no camera hook yet, so there sensitivity still only

merged.title: feat(multiplayer): add co-op rescue, host rally points and team tools
merged.author: momo1212221
merged.untrustedBody:
The existing co-op mod has no teammate rescue or shared gathering marker. This extends Multiplayer to 0.8.0 with a Team tools child page in the existing lobby and Multiplayer pause Options page, without consuming an additional native Options slot.

- Co-op rescue defers a normal lethal on-foot hit at one health when another party member is present. A living teammate on the same level must remain within six game units and hold L3 + R3 continuously for three seconds. The host checks fresh presence and live poses before granting rescue. Controls return at the retained one health, with two seconds of normal-hit protection.
- The host controls whether rescue is enabled and selects a 10/20/30-second window. Give up or an expired window passes the deferred hit to the original damage handler. Instant-kill hazards retain checkpoint behavior; no health/position memory or downed animation is substituted.
- Host-position rally markers are shared with distance feedback. Members may request a marker

merged.title: fix(keyboard-mouse): Menu: Circle answers the memory card's questions
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** creating save data (or formatting a card) asks in a freeze dialog (mode 4), where yes is Circle and no is Triangle (`update_mode_freeze`, states 6 and 13). In dialogs the mod gave Circle only to Backspace in the race dialog, so no key could create a save. Players worked around it by breaking the manifest (`menu_Circle`), which makes the mod refuse to load so the port's own E = Circle takes over.

**After:** Menu: Circle (E by default) presses Circle in every dialog too, so E creates the save and Backspace or right click cancels. Version 1.2.5.

**How:** one line in `buttons_for`'s Dialog case. Other keys, saved binds and game logic are unchanged. Manifest description and README table updated.

**Tested:** ctest of the whole repo passes (30/30); the new logic test fails without the fix. Not tested in game (no disc in the container): new game with no save, or Pause > Save on an empty card, then press E.
